meaning_by_symbol.CV: normal surface glow, dark core, hollow tap, thin hum
meaning_by_symbol.DR: drifting lights, blurred edges, wavering pitch
meaning_by_symbol.ES: too bright, layered hum, frozen patterns
meaning_by_symbol.BS: wobble edges or bulge, muffled hum
meaning_by_symbol.TB: hot all over but dim, red, rumble
meaning_by_symbol.A: one sustained same tone near all 6 faces simultaneously for the specified duration; let fade
meaning_by_symbol.B: bell opposite faces alternating; pause for the specified duration; 5 cycles
meaning_by_symbol.C: cloth on 2 adjacent edges by the specified face; then bell 3 times near the specified face
meaning_by_symbol.D: warm each corner of the specified face; then trace each edge
meaning_by_symbol.E: warm stone beside the specified face; rotate all faces
meaning_by_symbol.F: cool cloth over the whole Void for the specified duration; remove; fan the specified face and its opposite for the specified duration
meaning_by_symbol.G: dim lamp at the specified face and bright lamp at the opposite face simultaneously for the specified duration; do not move
meaning_by_symbol.H: folded cloth on the specified face for the specified duration; then bell each edge of the specified face twice
meaning_by_symbol.I: at each corner of the specified face: brief bell, then warm both meeting edges
meaning_by_symbol.J: flat board on the specified face for the specified duration; rotate and repeat each face-pair
meaning_by_symbol.K: bell the center of each face once starting from the specified face; then warm stone beside the Void for the specified duration
meaning_by_symbol.L: soft surface, specified face up, rest
meaning_by_symbol.M: cool cloth over the whole Void for the specified duration; remove; fan all 6 faces for the specified duration from the specified face
meaning_by_symbol.N: rotate with steady tone near opposite faces; then bell each corner
meaning_by_symbol.m: moderate; A means sustained same tone at all 6 SIM.

reply.rationale: No defensible multi-morpheme paradigm is attested in the supplied codebook. The only obvious recurring single symbols are standalone procedure labels (A–N, L, etc.) and standalone key-like items (T, R, g, f, m, SIM), but there are no supplied composed symbols that actually concatenate these into larger codes. The two-letter symbols (CV, DR, AC, ES, LE, LI, HI, PI, RC, CD, BS, PS, HS, TB) do not form meaning-predictable paradigms from attested subparts: their internal letters are not independently supported by substitution contrasts in shared frames. Under the evidence requirements, it is safer to treat the entire inventory as lexical rather than invent unattested morphology.
